text:
Aditi: Quick manager checklist + micro-scripts for goal-setting reviews — dropping a lightweight pack you can copy into 1:1s and calibration docs. Keep it terse, actionable.

Jules: love this. could you add an example for ICs vs managers? small tweak for career goals would help.

Aditi: sure — added two short examples below (IC + manager). main coaching points: 1) make the objective outcome-focused, 2) pick 1–2 measurable KRs, 3) avoid task lists.

Marcus: how should we tie to company priorities? new managers keep asking whether to reference top-level OKRs in each goal.

Aditi: short answer: yes — add a one-line alignment note (e.g., "supports Platform Reliability OKR: reduce tail latency"). but don't force every KR to be a direct mapping; use alignment to show intent.

people-ops-bot: Template saved: https://internal.redwood/docs/goal-templates (use "Manager Coaching Pack v1") :white_check_mark:

Aditi: Copyable snippets (paste into 1:1 or doc):
```
Objective: Improve query latency for 95th percentile across customer-facing APIs.
Why it matters: reduces user friction and supports Platform Efficiency OKR.
KR1: Reduce p95 latency from 420ms to <= 300ms for top 10 endpoints (measured in prod).
KR2: Deploy prefix caching on 3 highest-volume routes and validate with canary traffic (>=90% success).
```

Aditi: IC version (more execution-focused):
```
Objective: Lower p95 latency on route X to improve API responsiveness.
KR1: Implement and ship prefix cache for route X by end of quarter.
KR2: Add automated perf test for route X and keep regression <10% for main branch.
```

Ravi: Nice. Any suggested micro-phrases for managers during the convo? I need quick lines for "unclear" or "too vague."

Aditi: Yep — paste these in:
• "Help me understand how we’ll measure success for this objective."
• "This reads like a task list — can we convert the top 2 items into measurable results?"
• "I like the impact statement, can you add a single metric that demonstrates progress?"
• "If we miss the KR, what would success still look like?"

Elena: What about mid-quarter check-ins? short script?

Aditi: 1–2 lines you can use:
• "Quick check: which KR are you furthest behind on and why?"
• "If timelines slip, which KR should we deprioritize to preserve customer-facing outcomes?"

Marcus: Any guidance on calibration (ranking intensity)? we need a rubric for managers to compare similar goals across teams.

Aditi: keep calibration simple: Impact (high/med/low) + Confidence (quantified: 0–100% chance of hitting) + Effort (FTE weeks). put a one-line note in the doc like: "Impact/Confidence/Effort — e.g., High / 70% / 4w." We'll collect these in the calibration spreadsheet.

people-ops-bot: Reminder — quarterly goal submission window opens next Monday. Use the saved template and attach to the form.

Aditi: final doc checklist for managers before sign-off:
1) Objective is outcome not task.
2) 1–2 KRs only (measurable).
3) Add alignment note to company priority.
4) Add Impact/Confidence/Effort line for calibration.
5) Two-line coaching notes for 1:1 (what to push on).

Jules: stealing this for my new manager onboarding slides :grin:

Ravi: copying into my 1:1 agenda now — thank you.

Aditi: Happy to iterate — ping me if you want a variant for IC career goals or performance conversations.
